$comment: Triaged high/critical advisories, enforced by scripts/audit-gate.ts (bun run audit:ci).
Anything not listed here fails the build. Every entry needs a package, a reason, and
an expires date; the gate fails on an expired entry and on an entry that no longer
matches anything, so this file cannot quietly rot.
This list was 28 entries. Everything else was fixed rather than tolerated:
- OpenTelemetry advisories cleared by upgrading the direct dependencies to 0.221.x.
- The jws HMAC verification flaw (GHSA-869p-cjfg-cm3x) cleared by the jsonwebtoken
override; it sat under passport-jwt on the token verification path.
- The remaining 30-odd transitive advisories cleared by regenerating bun.lock. The
parents' caret ranges already permitted the fixed versions; only a stale lockfile
was holding the old resolutions in place.

GHSA-pm4m-ph32-ghv5.reason: Exponential parsing time on crafted YAML flow collections. No fix is reachable: @nestjs/swagger pins js-yaml at exactly 5.2.1, and a repository-wide override to 5.2.3 is not an option either, because cosmiconfig (js-yaml ^4) and @istanbuljs/load-nyc-config (js-yaml ^3) both call safeLoad/safeDump — removed in js-yaml 4 — so forcing one version across all three majors breaks config loading and coverage. Verified by grepping the installed tree, not assumed. Exposure is nil in practice: the advisory is in the parser, this application never parses YAML (no js-yaml import anywhere in src/), and @nestjs/swagger only serialises the generated OpenAPI document. Clears when @nestjs/swagger relaxes or bumps its pin.
